description: Defines the QuicBatchWriterBuffer class which manages an internal buffer for batching packet data in the quic namespace, including methods for pushing, popping, and inspecting buffered writes.

classes.name: QuicBatchWriterBuffer
classes.description: Manages a buffer for batching packet data, supporting push, pop, and buffer inspection operations.

classes.name: PushResult
classes.description: Result of a push operation indicating success and whether the buffer was copied.

classes.name: PopResult
classes.description: Result of a pop operation indicating how many buffers were popped and if remaining buffers were moved.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all buffered writes without altering the internal buffer.

methods.name: GetNextWriteLocation
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the next location for writing data.

methods.name: PushBufferedWrite
methods.description: Pushes a buffer into the internal buffer with associated addresses and options.

methods.name: PopBufferedWrite
methods.description: Removes a specified number of buffered writes from the front.

methods.name: buffered_writes
methods.description: Returns the deque of buffered writes.

methods.name: IsExternalBuffer
methods.description: Checks if a buffer is external.

methods.name: IsInternalBuffer
methods.description: Checks if a buffer is internal.

methods.name: SizeInUse
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes currently used in the buffer.

methods.name: DebugString
methods.description: Returns a string for debugging purposes.
